title: MCP Service Integration

warning.title: IMPORTANT
paragraphs: `MCP_SERVER_TOKEN` and `RAPTOR_SERVICE_API_KEY` are separate secrets with different trust boundaries. Do not reuse one value for both.

sections.title: Authentication boundary model
paragraphs: MCP clients authenticate to RAPTOR MCP using `Authorization: Bearer <MCP_SERVER_TOKEN>` on `/mcp`.
RAPTOR MCP authenticates upstream RAPTOR service API requests using `X-API-Key: <RAPTOR_SERVICE_API_KEY>`.
This split keeps client-facing MCP authentication independent from backend service-account key lifecycle.

sections.title: Client connection flow
paragraphs: MCP uses streamable HTTP at `POST/GET /mcp`. Health checks use `GET /healthz` without auth.
After authenticating with bearer token, client should initialize session, list tools, then call `list_records` or `list_pentests`.
orderedList: Run MCP session init and list tools. Expected tools: `list_records`, `list_pentests`.
Call tools and confirm RAPTOR service API responses are returned as JSON.
